summary: Phase4 improves LLM provider/model selection for large catalogs such as OpenRouter by reducing initial payload size and replacing datalist inputs with a reusable fuzzy model picker.
problem: The web UI loaded every provider model in /providers, relied on prefix-only datalist behavior, and could render hundreds of model chips in one advanced settings row.
target_users: Local AppForge-LLM v4 users connecting external LLM providers
Operators selecting models from large provider catalogs
desired_outcomes: /providers returns provider status without full model catalogs by default
Users can search model IDs and names with substring matching in quick connect, active model, and advanced provider settings
Provider models load only when a provider is selected or expanded
Advanced model chips show a bounded initial list with an explicit expand/collapse control
constraints: Use Vue 3 and existing TypeScript patterns without adding frontend dependencies
Keep API keys and OAuth credentials out of logs and browser payloads
Preserve existing provider save, test, activate, and quick-connect flows
assumptions: Phase4 decision F-1 uses the recommended option: remove the unused /providers/models all-provider endpoint
Phase4 decision F-2 uses the recommended option: in-memory model cache only
Manual model ID entry must remain possible even if lazy loading fails
non_goals: No live third-party LLM call without user credentials
